name: Thẻ Thường Trú (Permanent Residence Card)

requirements.blocker_text: Either awarded a Vietnamese state honor/recognition for contributions to Vietnam's construction and defense, or a scientist/specialist currently residing in Vietnam and nominated by the relevant ministry.
Legal place of residence and stable income sufficient to sustain living in Vietnam.

requirement_groups.name: Family member of a Vietnamese citizen or of a foreign permanent resident

requirements.blocker_text: Parent, spouse, or child of a Vietnamese citizen or of a foreigner who already holds Vietnamese permanent residence.
At least 3 years of continuous temporary residence in Vietnam.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 3 years of continuous legal temporary residence in Vietnam.

requirement_groups.name: Stateless persons resident since 2000 or earlier

requirements.blocker_text: A stateless person who has continuously resided in Vietnam since 2000 or earlier.

evidence_required.document: Evidence of qualifying category (state honor decision, ministry nomination, family relationship documents, or statelessness/residence history)
Proof of legal housing and stable income

sources.title: Ministry of Public Security (Bo Cong An) official public-service portal -- Permanent Residence Card procedure: qualifying categories (state-honored contributors, ministry-nominated scientists/experts), legal-housing and stable-income conditions, Ministry of Public Security approval, 4-month (+2-month) processing

Luat Viet An (law firm) -- Permanent Residence Card: family-sponsored category (3 years' continuous temporary residence, Vietnamese-citizen relative already a permanent resident) and stateless-persons-resident-since-2000 category

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Vietnam). STATUS: DRAFT -- the meritorious/expert categories and the general legal-housing/income conditions are tier-1 (Ministry of Public Security's own portal, confirmed by direct fetch), but the family-sponsored category's specific 3-year residence figure and the stateless-since-2000 category come only from a tier-3 law-firm source, not independently re-confirmed against the Ministry's own text -- held draft accordingly, with the mix disclosed rather than presented as uniformly tier-1. This is a genuinely NARROW permanent-residence system compared to most countries in this dataset: there is no general 'X years of any qualifying temporary residence' pathway open to ordinary workers or investors -- eligibility is limited to four specific categories (merit/honors, nominated scientists/experts, family of a Vietnamese citizen or of an existing PR holder, and long-resident stateless persons). vn_investor_residence.json and vn_work_permit.json both note this: an investor or worker does not automatically become PR-eligible after any number of years under Vietnamese law as currently documented, unlike most other countries in this dataset -- flagged prominently since it's easy to wrongly assume a generic 'work N years -> get PR' pipeline exists here.
